# UiAvatar

Shows a person or entity as an image, falling back to initials and then to a generic glyph.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | display |
| Import | `import { UiAvatar } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import UiAvatar from '@your-scope/ui/components/UiAvatar'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/display/UiAvatar.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/display/UiAvatar.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` |  | Image URL. Falls back to initials, then to a generic glyph, if it is missing or fails. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Person or entity name: the accessible name and the source of the initials. |
| `initials` | `string` |  | Explicit initials (otherwise derived from `name`). |
| `size` | `UiSize` |  | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `UiProvider` `defaults`, then to `ui.config.ts`. |
| `shape` | `'circle' \| 'square'` | `'circle'` |  |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fallback` |  | Custom fallback content shown when there is no usable image. |

## Attributes

The root `<span>`.

## Accessibility

- The image uses `name` as `alt`.
- When the fallback shows, the root is `role="img"` named by `name`.
- A failed image load switches to the fallback automatically.

## Styling

- `.vui-avatar`, `.vui-avatar__image`, `.vui-avatar__initials`
- `data-size`, `data-shape`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/DisplayDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/DisplayDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
  <UiAvatar name="Ada Lovelace" size="sm" />
  <UiAvatar name="Grace Hopper" />
  <UiAvatar name="山田 太郎" size="lg" />
  <UiAvatar name="Alan Turing" shape="square" />
  <!-- A source that cannot be decoded: the avatar falls back to initials (no network request involved). -->
  <UiAvatar name="Broken image" src="data:image/png;base64,AAAA" />
  <UiAvatar />
</div>
```
